mapper.select: SELECT (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking b JOIN lesson l ON b.lesson_id = l.id JOIN tutor_availability ta ON b.availability_id = ta.id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND ta.start_at >= NOW() AND b.canceled_at IS NULL AND b.done_at IS NULL) AS upcomingLessons, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM booking b JOIN lesson l ON b.lesson_id = l.id JOIN tutor_availability ta ON b.availability_id = ta.id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND b.canceled_at IS NULL AND (ta.start_at < NOW() OR b.done_at IS NOT NULL)) AS completedLessons, (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM review r JOIN booking b ON r.booking_id = b.id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId}) AS totalReviews, COALESCE((SELECT SUM(p.amount) FROM payment p JOIN booking b ON p.booking_id = b.id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND p.status = 'PAID'), 0) AS totalSpent

SELECT b.id AS bookingId, l.id AS lessonId, l.user_id AS tutorId, tp.id AS tutorProfileId, u.name AS tutorName, l.title AS subject, ta.start_at AS startAt, ta.end_at AS endAt, CASE WHEN b.canceled_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'CANCELLED' WHEN b.done_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN b.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'CONFIRMED' ELSE 'PENDING' END AS status, l.price AS price FROM booking b JOIN lesson l ON b.lesson_id = l.id JOIN tutor_availability ta ON b.availability_id = ta.id JOIN users u ON l.user_id = u.id JOIN tutor_profile tp ON l.user_id = tp.user_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND ta.start_at >= NOW() AND b.canceled_at IS NULL AND b.done_at IS NULL ORDER BY ta.start_at ASC

SELECT b.id AS bookingId, l.id AS lessonId, l.user_id AS tutorId, tp.id AS tutorProfileId, u.name AS tutorName, l.title AS subject, ta.start_at AS startAt, ta.end_at AS endAt, CASE WHEN b.canceled_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'CANCELLED' WHEN b.done_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'COMPLETED' WHEN b.confirmed_at IS NOT NULL THEN 'CONFIRMED' ELSE 'PENDING' END AS status, l.price AS price FROM booking b JOIN lesson l ON b.lesson_id = l.id JOIN tutor_availability ta ON b.availability_id = ta.id JOIN users u ON l.user_id = u.id JOIN tutor_profile tp ON l.user_id = tp.user_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} AND (ta.start_at < NOW() OR b.done_at IS NOT NULL OR b.canceled_at IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY ta.start_at DESC

SELECT r.id AS reviewId, l.user_id AS tutorId, tp.id AS tutorProfileId, u.name AS tutorName, r.rating, r.content, r.created_at AS createdAt FROM review r JOIN booking b ON r.booking_id = b.id JOIN lesson l ON b.lesson_id = l.id JOIN users u ON l.user_id = u.id JOIN tutor_profile tp ON l.user_id = tp.user_id WHERE b.user_id = #{userId} ORDER BY r.created_at DESC
